historical_reviews.v3_1: Persistent logging-policy changes require explicit confirmation and cannot be tested by clearing the very evidence whose retention is being controlled.

original_test_intent: Change the BMC's SEL full/capacity retention behavior to one approved storage mode, verify the configured policy and bounded effect, then restore the captured baseline without deleting prior events.
original_method: Preserve both conflicting source opcodes and issue neither until the vendor contract identifies the setter, request value and getter; build acceptance around mode read-back and non-destructive retention evidence.
manual_activity: The reliability/logging owner resolves setter/getter mapping, selects the exact mode, approves the expected overwrite/stop-on-full behavior, bounded event stimulus and restoration plan.
required_inputs: Current mode and immutable SEL export/hash
Approved target mode and retention-policy oracle
Bounded safe event stimulus or non-mutating configuration-only scope
Original-mode restore and explicit owner approval
safety_requirements: Do not clear SEL, dmesg or syslog
Do not guess the setter opcode or mode byte
Preserve existing SEL externally before mutation
Do not fill SEL to capacity unless separately authorized
Use only bounded nonhazardous event stimulus
Stop if existing records disappear or logging changes beyond scope
Restore the original mode on every planned rollback
No reset, power action or automatic retry
agent_execution_scope: Verify target and approved setter/getter contract
Export/hash SEL and read the baseline mode
Present exact request, policy effect and recovery for OK
Observe only the approved bounded retention behavior
Restore baseline when required and confirm it
Archive SEL diff, mode and command audit
engineer_actions: Resolve 0x83 versus 0x43 and define mode encoding
Approve retention/overwrite acceptance and safe stimulus

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: A bare 0x30/0x43 request has no mode parameter and may be the paired getter, so it cannot safely perform the named set operation; lan print is not a logging-policy read-back.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After vendor resolution, export SEL, read baseline with the approved getter, issue one route-correct setter request with the approved mode byte, verify getter read-back and bounded retention behavior, then restore the baseline mode if required.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Both source opcodes and 10/5 timing are retained as conflict evidence; mode value, selector layout and observation stimulus are not inferred.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Treat storage mode as a reversible evidence-retention policy change with external SEL backup, byte-exact write, independent getter verification and a bounded non-destructive policy oracle.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds the missing mode and read-back, prevents evidence clearing and distinguishes configuration success from actual retention behavior.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Mode read-back alone does not prove capacity behavior, while a capacity-fill test is a separate destructive scope requiring explicit authorization.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong mode may silently overwrite older diagnostic records or stop recording new events when full, affecting later incident analysis long after the command completes.

project_override_considerations: A WebUI or vendor API may substitute only with documented mapping to the identical retention mode and read-back; Clear SEL and generic LAN output are never equivalent.
expected_evidence: Approved target/firmware/opcode/value mapping and owner confirmation
Immutable pre-change SEL export/hash and baseline mode
Redacted exact set request/response, completion and timing
Documented getter response and decoded target mode
Bounded retention-policy evidence with no loss of pre-existing events
Restored mode and post-restore verification when required

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The Master gives in-band opcode 0x83 with a selector but OOB opcode 0x43 with neither selector nor mode, while the adjacent getter also uses 0x43 OOB. Without a vendor ruling, the named setter is not uniquely identified.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The logging-policy mutation and recovery objective are identifiable. Vendor mapping, exact mode and safe oracle are explicit prerequisites, so the case is not irreducibly BLOCKED.

review_improvement: Prevents an ambiguous getter-like command from changing evidence policy, supplies a reversible mode lifecycle and preserves the SEL as the primary integrity witness.
independent_technical_reasoning: Storage mode governs what happens when event capacity is exhausted, so its harm can be delayed. The same bare OOB opcode appears in the getter and setter rows, making command identity non-negotiable. Correct review therefore requires an externally preserved SEL, a distinct setter value, getter confirmation and tightly bounded behavior evidence without capacity destruction by default.
